import json,collections
cards=[json.loads(s) for s in open('items.jsonl')]
a=[json.loads(s) for s in open('answers.jsonl')]
for i in range(50,57):
 o=a[i-1]
 o.update(letters='y',marks='na' if i in {50,53} else 'y',crop_ok='y',errors=[],detail='',owner_crop=dict.fromkeys(['one_central_line','text_ne_visible_line','other_complete_line','gt2_whole_neighbour_words','turned_or_clipped'],'no'),where=[],segmentation_detail='')
a[51].update(crop_ok='n',errors=['merged_two_lines'],segmentation_detail='Two complete copies of the line are visible; label contains one copy.')
a[51]['owner_crop'].update(one_central_line='yes',text_ne_visible_line='yes',other_complete_line='yes',gt2_whole_neighbour_words='yes')
a[53].update(crop_ok='n',segmentation_detail='Text is turned 90 degrees.')
a[53]['owner_crop']['turned_or_clipped']='yes'
a[54].update(crop_ok='n',errors=['crop_overrun'],segmentation_detail='Substantial lower bodies of preceding line visible above, and slivers below; no whole neighbour words.')
a[55].update(letters='n',errors=['wrong_letter'],detail='итти → ишти',where=[{'label':'ишти','printed':'итти'}])
with open('answers.jsonl','w') as f:
 for o in a:f.write(json.dumps(o,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
# Validate the saved artifact, including exact count and order.
out=[json.loads(s) for s in open('answers.jsonl')]
assert len(out)==len(cards)==56
assert [o['card_id'] for o in out]==[c['card_id'] for c in cards]
for o in out:
 assert set(['card_id','letters','marks','crop_ok','errors','detail','owner_crop','where']).issubset(o)
 assert o['letters'] in ['y','n','u'] and o['marks'] in ['y','n','na'] and o['crop_ok'] in ['y','n']
 assert all(v in ['yes','no','uncertain'] for v in o['owner_crop'].values())
print('Count and order verified:',len(out))
for k in ['letters','marks','crop_ok']:print(k,dict(collections.Counter(o[k] for o in out)))
print('errors',collections.Counter(e for o in out for e in o['errors']).most_common())
